name: PENFOLD, Alison Louise

headline.note: Futureye is now identified as the private advisory agency; Woolworths manager/acting-head titles are corroborated. New NFF communications, carp-control governance and party roles are separated from political staff and ALEC leadership. Vaile-office years are 2004–2006, while other appointment boundaries, ordinary hours, leave and overlaps remain incomplete. No public/private full-time duration is supportable from titles or isolated observations.

career_spells.role: Assisted at market stalls during childhood
career_spells.evidence_note: Penfold describes spending childhood weekends helping her parents' seven-days-a-week retail market business across western Sydney and later Taree. Pay, dates, hours and legal employment status are not established.
career_spells.counting_note: Pay is undocumented; neither unpaid status nor substantive private full-time work is inferred.

career_spells.role: Economics and Asian Studies student, specialising in Korean language
career_spells.evidence_note: The member biography identifies the course and a 1993 university exchange to South Korea but gives no enrolment or completion dates, qualification outcome, study load or work overlap. Public professional index supplies the displayed boundaries; earlier unknown-date notes are superseded only at this precision. Hours, leave and continuity remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Penfold dates her first parliamentary work experience with Mark Vaile to 1994. Duration, duties, pay and relationship to university study are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Work experience is not treated as paid employment without evidence.

career_spells.employer: Parliamentary and ministerial offices (employing offices unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: Penfold's first speech says she progressed through receptionist and whips-clerk roles before adviser and chief-of-staff positions. The employing offices, sequence, exact titles, payroll, dates, hours and leave are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political and parliamentary staff work is excluded from the narrow headline.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. Peter Reith MP
career_spells.evidence_note: The first speech and biography include Reith among the ministers for whom Penfold worked across roles extending from administration to adviser/chief of staff. The specific title, payroll, dates, hours and leave are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political-staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. Mark Vaile MP
career_spells.evidence_note: Penfold says she later worked for Vaile and includes him in the offices across which she advanced to senior adviser/chief-of-staff level; contemporary campaign material also identifies work for the former Deputy Prime Minister. Exact title transitions, dates, payroll, hours and leave are unresolved. Public professional-profile entry supplies 2004–2006; title progression and exact dates remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Political-staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. Warren Truss MP
career_spells.evidence_note: The first speech and biography identify service for Warren Truss but do not specify title, payroll, dates, hours, leave or its position relative to private-sector roles.
career_spells.counting_note: Political-staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. Terry Mills MLA, Northern Territory
career_spells.role: Chief of Staff and senior adviser to the Northern Territory Opposition Leader
career_spells.evidence_note: The member biography says Penfold worked in the Northern Territory for Terry Mills. Exact title, employing entity, dates, payroll, hours, leave and relocation boundaries are unresolved. Conference biography confirms the chief-of-staff title; exact tenure still unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political-staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Government Relations Manager; observed acting Head of Government Relations
career_spells.evidence_note: Penfold's biography and a contemporaneous industry profile identify the Woolworths government-relations role. Exact appointment and cessation dates, hours, leave and overlap with political staff or advisory work are unresolved. Parliamentary witness programme adds the acting-head title. It does not establish promotion or acting-tenure boundaries. Public professional index supplies the displayed boundaries; earlier unknown-date notes are superseded only at this precision. Hours, leave and continuity remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employer control is clear, but title alone and missing boundaries do not establish a countable full-time interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen parliamentary record gives February 2012 to July 2016. ABC reported that Penfold took over in early 2012 and would finish on 29 July 2016; the LiveCorp 2015–16 annual report independently records the July 2016 end. Hours, leave and exact February start day are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: ALEC is an industry peak body representing livestock exporters, so its CEO role is classified as employer-association work and excluded from the narrow public/private headline.

career_spells.evidence_note: A September 2020 first-person interview and January 2021 conference profile identify Futureye, a management consultancy focused on social licence, risk and communications. These are observations within tenure, not appointment endpoints. Legal entity, equity, contract basis, remuneration, hours, leave and relationship to political work remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: A director title does not by itself prove substantive full-time private employment.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. David Littleproud MP
career_spells.evidence_note: Contemporary FRDC project contact records and later first-person/conference biographies establish Chief of Staff to the Minister for Agriculture and Water Resources, David Littleproud. Exact appointment, cessation, payroll, hours and leave remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political-staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. Kevin Hogan MP, Shadow Minister for Trade and Tourism
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen record supplies the title and portfolio but no dates. The first speech and member biography confirm service for Hogan. Appointment, cessation, payroll, hours, leave and overlap with the 2022 Senate campaign remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political-staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Office of the Hon. Dr David Gillespie MP
career_spells.evidence_note: First speech and member biography confirm Gillespie-office service; contemporary reporting identifies senior-adviser work. Preselection on 18 December 2024 is not proof employment ceased, so the unsupported endpoint is removed. Campaign leave, hours and actual cessation remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political-staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: Secondary election chronology identifies 2021 preselection and an unsuccessful 2022 Senate candidacy. Exact nomination date, campaign remuneration, hours and employment overlap are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party candidacy and campaigning are excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The NSW Nationals announced preselection on 18 December 2024; the frozen roster records election on 3 May 2025. Campaign remuneration, hours and overlap with Gillespie's office or private work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party candidacy and campaigning are excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Lyne
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster, current Parliament profile and Australian Government Directory establish continuing service as Member for Lyne from the 3 May 2025 election.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Acting general manager, communications and media (five-week contract)
career_spells.evidence_note: Institutional joint release identifies NFF media work on 8 December 2016; contemporary industry reporting describes a temporary role before the incoming communications manager. Appointment dates, contract duration, pay, hours and leave unknown. Public professional index supplies the displayed boundaries; earlier unknown-date notes are superseded only at this precision. Hours, leave and continuity remain unresolved. Stated five-week term is not interpreted as two full months or evidence of full-time hours.
career_spells.counting_note: Employer-association work excluded; source observations are not tenure boundaries.

career_spells.employer: National Carp Control Plan / Fisheries Research and Development Corporation
career_spells.evidence_note: FRDC project report records departure before the February–May 2018 interim chair arrangement. Governance role retained separately; contractual employer, pay, hours and tenure dates not established.
career_spells.counting_note: Committee governance is not assumed to be substantive full-time public employment.

career_spells.evidence_note: Current parliamentary biography gives this role and range. Remuneration, hours and overlap with other employment unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party organisational work excluded.

research_notes: Blocked pending a dated CV or appointment records separating receptionist, whips-clerk, adviser, senior-adviser and chief-of-staff service across the Reith, Vaile, Truss, Mills, Littleproud, Hogan and Gillespie offices, including payroll, hours, leave and breaks.
Identify Woolworths appointment and cessation dates, employment basis, hours and leave; identify the boutique agency, legal entity, ownership, duties, remuneration, dates and workload.
Obtain the exact ALEC February 2012 start day, hours and leave, although the role remains an employer-association exclusion under the codebook.
Resolve ANU study dates and its overlap with the 1994 Vaile placement and early parliamentary employment; determine whether any other paid roles or career gaps are omitted.
Determine campaign remuneration and employment overlaps for the 2022 Senate candidacy and 2024–2025 Lyne campaign.
No public or private full-time duration is inferred from senior titles, a narrative 30-plus-year career, undated private roles or business directorship. Missing evidence is not zero.

2026-10-01 follow-up identifies Futureye, temporary NFF communications work, NCCP communications-chair governance and two party offices. Corroborates chief-of-staff titles, adds Vaile 2004–2006 profile years and Woolworths acting title. Removes preselection day as an employment endpoint and unsupported unpaid label for family assistance.

Searched member/first-person and conference biographies, parliamentary witness/party records, FRDC historical project report, NFF institutional releases and public professional profile. Direct LinkedIn returned 999; APH direct pages were restricted/unavailable while indexed text was accessible. Detailed month-level career reconstruction on a contact-data aggregator was not used as verified evidence; seek original dated CV/appointments.

Remaining leads: Futureye corporate/payroll history and exact tenure; NFF temporary contract and earlier/later communications records; NCCP chair contract; Woolworths appointment/acting interval; Reith/Truss/Mills/Hogan/Gillespie title transitions, campaign leave and career/travel breaks. No hours inferred from job advertisements for Penfold’s own later staff.

Second follow-up2October2026 supplies month-level Woolworths and NFF contract boundaries, ANU study years and a separately excluded volunteer mentoring role. Public profile places a personal Camino pilgrimage inAugust–September2016. First-person Aurora interview describes walking after leaving a job in2016 and again in2019; retain these breaks rather than assume continuous work across transitions. A Littleproud-office indexed fragment givesMarch–May2018 without a clearly associated title; do not apply it to the entire chief-of-staff tenure, which contemporary August2018 reporting also observes. Exact title progression, later consultancy boundaries, ordinary hours and leave remain unresolved. Burgmann alumni1990–1992 residence is not degree completion. Search snippets and broad career narratives are not evidence of continuous full-time work.
